name: Greenergy Data Centers Tallinn DC-1 / MCF campus
notes: Saue Parish/Hüüru area near Tallinn; first building opened in 2022; full campus described as three buildings and 31.5 MW.

name: Greenergy Data Centers Hüüru expansion
notes: Caverion-reported EUR 50m expansion package for electrical, cooling, ventilation and fire protection systems; completion targeted for autumn 2026.

name: CITIC Telecom CPC DataHOUSE@Tallinn
notes: Official CITIC page lists Tallinn data center, carrier-neutral connectivity, 600 m2 facility, Tier II design basis and 2N redundancy on critical systems.

name: Telia Laagri data center
notes: DCD reported Telia Estonia building a solar plant next to its Laagri data center in Harju County.

name: Linxdatacenter Tallinn
notes: Baxtel lists Linxdatacenter Tallinn as an operational carrier-neutral data center in the Tallinn market.

name: Burfa Tech / Enefit Technology Park Narva HPC center
developer: Burfa Tech OÜ / Enefit Technology Park
notes: Located at Enefit Technology Park near Narva/Balti Power Plant; announced as 4 MW HPC/data processing center with equipment testing and launch expected within months.

name: Astrec Data Jõhvi
notes: Aggregator listings place Astrec Data at Tartu põik 5, Jõhvi, with 1.5 MW fully built-out power and 1,600 sq.m. whitespace; Data Center Platform lists one Astrec Data Estonia facility in Jõhvi.

name: Narva Datacenter
notes: FairyHosting offers colocation in Estonia and lists a Narva presence; directory sources identify Narva DC at Ak./Mihail Maslovi 1 in Kreenholm/Narva.

name: Sunly Risti AI data center campus
notes: Planned outside Risti in Lääne-Nigula municipality; Sunly applied for planning permission for a 180 MW AI data center, with parts potentially online by 2028.

name: Evecon Lihula data center
notes: Evecon is seeking building rights from Lääneranna Municipality for a site northwest of Lihula; plan includes up to six data center buildings, cooling facilities, 330 kV substation and auxiliary buildings.

name: Unnamed Lihula-area data center prospect
notes: Lääneranna deputy mayor told ERR that another developer had asked the municipality to reserve a nearby plot and was carrying out analyses; completion and timing unknown.
